## Deviations / deferrals

- **Live leg DEFERRED (`D-P36.75-1`):** the OM-20 naming authorises the
  write (GATE-G5 §4, verbatim, expires GATE-G6) but the `hosted` env is
  absent — no `SIG_GCP_PROJECT`, no ADC, no claim-spine writer DSN. The
  leg queues `prepared_not_executed`; re-run prompt verbatim:
  `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/385_P36.75__flock-share-lists-configured-access.md live_verification=true`.
- **Dedupe is semantic + sink-side:** the plan reports
  `edges_already_claimed` on (subject, to_org) keys; the apply's
  `ON CONFLICT` dedupes on `content_digest`, so a changed
  `corroborated`/`observations_count` lands a NEW claim row — honest
  append-only observation semantics, never an update.
- **Portal-derived lists ride `sig.flock-portal-page/1`:** probe
  extractions are the only portal bytes admitted (P36.74 persists the
  screened extraction, never raw pages); each binds its own stored
  capture by digest.
